title: One Basis to Animate Them All: Gaussian Blendshape Distillation for Real-Time Avatars
why_read: A clever and well-validated technique for making real-time 3D avatar animation dramatically cheaper on mobile devices.
analysis: This paper tackles a genuine bottleneck in 3D Gaussian avatar rendering: the neural network inference needed each frame to animate a character is expensive, especially on mobile hardware. The authors show that this per-frame neural computation can be approximated by a simple linear combination of precomputed 'blendshapes', similar to classic facial animation techniques, learned via a shallow coefficient predictor. This cuts CPU animation cost by up to 1000x while keeping most of the visual quality, and works across different existing avatar models without retraining them. The result is a practical, broadly applicable speedup for VR/AR and mobile avatar applications, backed by concrete numbers.
